jobs.title: Senior Frontend Engineer (all genders)
jobs.facts: Backed by three leading VCs (Creandum, Northzone, and Lightrock), and now, following our recent €30 m Series B, we are ready to push beyond. | Our product attracts the biggest names in travel technology, such as Booking.com and Google Maps, and national carriers like Amtrak, Deutsche Bahn, Renfe, and SNCF. | We offer flexible and remote working conditions, relocation opportunities and career growth in a small and developing company.

jobs.title: Senior Product Engineer, eComm (all gender)
jobs.facts: Workplace: Berlin & Hybrid: HQ office in Berlin, where the team often meets. | Remote: We are a remote-first company with teams located around the Globe. | You have: Several years of experience building and operating backend services in Python, with ownership across the full lifecycle: design, implementation, deployment, monitoring, and maintenance (other languages such as Ruby, Typescript, are a plus). | Experience with frameworks: preferably FastAPI, Django, ReactJS. | Fluent in English, both verbal and written. | Our partners include Booking.com , Google Maps, Amtrak, Deutsche Bahn, Renfe, and SNCF. | Enjoy flexible and remote-friendly working options, relocation opportunities, and plenty
